key_extension_hooks.purpose: Single source of truth for the platform fee AMOUNT (CommissionService::compute_breakdown). Pro TieredCommission (flat rules) + SubscriptionManager (plan commission_override) hook this; the Stripe Connect split reads the PERSISTED result, never recomputes. Pairs with wpss_commission_rate (percentage) + wpss_commission_base_amount (base).
